elements.description:
An evaluation set's cases – input, expected output, checks, tags and split – in a windowed table with a case editor,
split counts and a comparison with an earlier version.

properties.name: value
properties.description: The set. Changed by the user unless a tc-value-change listener calls preventDefault()

properties.name: splits
properties.default: [ { id: "train", label: "Train" }, { id: "validation", label: "Validation" }, { id: "test", label: "Test" }, ]
properties.description: The splits a case can go in, in order – train, validation and test by default

properties.name: assertionTypes
properties.default: [ { id: "contains", label: "Contains", placeholder: "Text the answer must include", description: "Passes when the answer includes this text" }, { id: "equals", label: "Equals", placeholder: "The exact answer", description: "Passes when the answer is exactly this" }, { id: "schema", label: "Matches schema", placeholder: '{ "type": "object", "required": ["answer"] }', description: "Passes when the answer is JSON that fits this JSON Schema", multiline: true, json: true }, { id: "rubric", label: "Rubric", placeholder: "What a good answer does, for a grader to judge", description: "A grader scores the answer against this criterion", multiline: true }, ]
properties.description: The kinds of check a case can have – contains, equals, matches schema and rubric by default

properties.name: versions
properties.description: Earlier snapshots of the set, oldest first, offered in the Compare select

properties.name: compare
properties.description: The id of the version to compare with, or "" for none. Changed by the user unless tc-compare-change is prevented

properties.name: open
properties.description: The id of the case open in the editor, or null. Changed by the user unless tc-open-change is prevented

properties.name: description
properties.description: A quieter line beside the heading, e.g. what the set tests

properties.name: maxHeight
properties.description: The table's height before it scrolls, in px

properties.name: name
properties.description: Submitted with the form: the set as JSON

properties.name: disabled
properties.description: Turns every control off and leaves the set out of the form; a disabled fieldset does the same

properties.name: problems
properties.description: Every problem in the set, in case order

properties.name: comparison
properties.description: What changed since the compared version; null when not comparing

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

events.name: tc-value-change
events.description: A case was added, edited, deleted or restored ({ value }: EvaluationDatasetValueChange); cancelable – prevent it to control `value`

events.name: tc-open-change
events.description: A case was opened or closed ({ open }: EvaluationDatasetOpenChange – the case id or null); cancelable

events.name: tc-compare-change
events.description: A version to compare with was picked ({ compare }: EvaluationDatasetCompareChange – a version id, or "" for none); cancelable

events.name: tc-import
events.description: Import was pressed: the app reads a file and sets `value`; no detail

events.name: tc-export
events.description: Export was pressed ({ value, jsonl }: EvaluationDatasetExport – the set and the same set as JSON Lines)

functions.name: evaluationDatasetIssues
functions.signature: evaluationDatasetIssues(value: EvaluationDatasetValue, o: { assertionTypes?: EvaluationAssertionType[]; splits?: EvaluationSplit[] }): EvaluationIssue[]
functions.description: Every problem in a set, case by case in order

functions.name: compareEvaluationDatasets
functions.signature: compareEvaluationDatasets(base: readonly EvaluationCase[], current: readonly EvaluationCase[]): EvaluationComparison
functions.description: The cases added, edited (same id, different content) and removed since `base`

functions.name: evaluationDatasetToJsonl
functions.description: The set as JSON Lines – one case per line

functions.name: evaluationDatasetFromJsonl
functions.signature: evaluationDatasetFromJsonl(text: string): { value: EvaluationDatasetValue; errors: string[] }
functions.description: Reads JSON Lines back into a set; lines that can't be read are skipped and reported with their line number

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The set to start with when uncontrolled

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the whole set after every edit

props.name: compare
props.description: The id of the version to compare with, "" for none (controlled)

props.name: defaultCompare
props.description: The version to compare with on mount when `compare` isn't controlled

props.name: onCompareChange
props.description: A version to compare with was picked ("" for none)

props.name: open
props.description: The id of the open case, or null (controlled when given)

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: A case was opened or closed (its id, or null)

props.name: onImport
props.description: Import was pressed – read a file and pass the cases back through `value`

props.name: onExport
props.description: Export was pressed, with the set and the same set as JSON Lines
